content: ESP32 runtime AP/STA switching pattern (arduino-esp32, WiFi.h + Preferences.h both in core, no lib_deps needed): persist ssid/pass/mode in NVS via Preferences; on boot read prefs, if STA configured do WiFi.persistent(false) (stops autoconnect to stale NVS wifi creds), WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA), WiFi.begin(ssid,pass), wait WL_CONNECTED with timeout (D-40 ~20s), else fall back WiFi.mode(WIFI_AP)+softAP. Mode switches at runtime go through WiFi.mode(WIFI_MODE_NULL)/disconnect first. WiFiManager library exists but adds a captive portal; D-40's own UI card + Preferences is lighter and fits the existing settings-card pattern. References: docs.espressif.com arduino-esp32 WiFi API, SO 65230038, randomnerdtutorials.
